findings.text: the recorded gate is narrower than the node's named check: the brief required the two named parser files plus every test file asserting on reports.py, but the baseline and after commands cover only four files and omit tests/test_crew_recovery.py, which directly imports reports and asserts the unknown-status classification at line 1414; calling this the prescribed four-file gate therefore records an incomplete check. The omitted relevant test passes independently at the reviewed head, so this is missing evidence rather than an observed regression.
